results.exact_unused_slice: ShapPFN specifically — a single-forward-pass Shapley-attributing tabular foundation model (PFN + ViaSHAP) — applied to youth talent-ID/projection where (a) zero-shot/in-context learning fits the inherently small, fragmented per-academy cohorts that block conventional gradient-boosted models, and (b) the built-in real-time Shapley attribution is used to surface and audit relative-age/maturation features per-prospect so scouts can interrogate WHY a model favors a player. No deployed/published artifact seen that uses an attribution-native tabular FM for maturation-bias-aware youth projection.
results.honest_adjacency: Both axes are densely occupied and the technique-family already touches a sibling: (1) niche — talent-ID ML is a surveyed field with deployed draft models (NFL Next Gen Stats, NBA ML big boards) and algorithmic RAE/maturation correction methods already exist; (2) technique — TabPFN (ShapPFN's direct parent family) is already applied to sports analytics (xG), and SHAP/Shapley explainability is already standard in soccer player market-value and scouting models. The novelty is confined to the precise pairing of the attribution-native PFN variant with small-data maturation-bias-aware youth projection; the surrounding cells are filled.
results.reasoning: CLOSED rejected: no source shows ShapPFN (or any single-pass Shapley tabular FM) deployed/published on youth talent-ID. OPEN rejected decisively: there IS adjacency on BOTH axes after reformulation — TabPFN-on-sports (technique family on sibling) and SHAP-on-player-eval + RAE-correction models + deployed draft models (niche). Per gate, any adjacency on both axes => NARROW. Adversarial effort: targeted commercial (NFL/NBA), the correction-model sub-literature, and the parent-FM-on-sibling angle; all returned hits, none the exact cell.

results.exact_unused_slice: Molmo2-style point/grounding VLM as the adjudicator in ambiguous warehouse RECEIVING: pointing to the specific damaged region or to the PO-vs-physical mismatch on a unit and emitting a grounded accept / reject / quarantine disposition with a localized visual rationale. The combination of (a) point-grounded localization of the defect/discrepancy AND (b) the three-way disposition decision in inbound receiving was not found as a deployed product or paper. Existing systems either localize damage with traditional CNN defect-pattern matching (no NL grounding, no disposition reasoning) or do PO matching on text/barcode data (no vision grounding).
results.honest_adjacency: Strong adjacency on BOTH axes. Niche: warehouse damage-detection CV with automated reject/reroute is commercially deployed (Arvist AI, xis.ai, AWL India), the accept/reject/quarantine disposition is a standardized WMS workflow (Infor, SG Systems), and PO/SKU-mismatch receiving automation is a shipping WMS feature (JASCI, SkuSavvy). Technique: VLM-based visual inspection exists (2502.09057), and the pointing/grounding family is already aimed at defect localization via the Industrial Defect Impact Grounding task and Molmo's own 'artifact detection' framing; MolmoPoint/VideoMolmo extend the exact family. So neither the warehouse-receiving niche nor the grounding-VLM-for-defects technique is empty.
results.reasoning: CLOSED rejected: query 5 (most specific) explicitly returned no multimodal/grounding-VLM system for damaged-goods receiving adjudication; commercial damage CV uses traditional pattern matching, and PO-matching is text/barcode-based. OPEN rejected decisively: heavy adjacency on both axes — IDIG + Molmo 'artifact detection' (technique family on sibling defect task) and deployed warehouse damage CV + PO-mismatch automation + defined quarantine workflow (niche). Per gate, adjacency on both axes => NARROW. Adversarial effort spanned commercial WMS vendors, the grounding-for-defects academic task, and the exact agentic-adjudication phrasing.
